text_block_list.name: Candidates
text_block_list.text: ...Guh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Without knocking it over... 
If you can't pull it in one try, that's 
the end...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
An 8-tier tower... huh. 
I have to admit, the pressure is real...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, tablecloth pulls are all about 
mentality in the end. 
They say the key is to not flinch and just 
commit—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's one shot with zero practice, 
right? 
Unless you go in with serious resolve—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whatever. Then I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
How weird. Why are you all so scared of 
this? 
All you gotta do is yank the cloth—just 
watch me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Hyaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“OOOOHHH!! Whoa, for real?!” 
“Whaaa! Sweepy-chan, that was so cool!!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
See that?! For the magical girl Sweepy, 
something like this is a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now make the next challenge way harder, 
got it?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!!!! 
Sweepy cleared it in one try!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Big Sis, you gotta go next! 
I bet you'll look waaay cooler—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, right... I need to go soon, too...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: But... can I really... do it...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Vivlos, ...I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! B-Big Sis?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *pant*—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so stupid... Running away like 
this...! 
...And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“Sink or swim, you only get one shot! 
Give it a go whenever you're ready, my 
rough diamonds♪”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (A single chance, a decisive showdown...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(In crucial moments like that, how many 
times did I—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A memorable race, huh~? Hmm, so hard to 
choose! 
I love all of Big Sis's races—oh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's the 'Shuka Sho', right! 
I super love that one too! I cried so 
hard!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-san's late charge was incredible, 
but Big Sis held on and on all the way to 
the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “Today for sure... this time, I will—”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “I will—!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “—HAAAAAAAHHH!!!!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (I couldn't win...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how many times I challenged 
her... 
Even when I was certain this was my 
moment, I couldn't reach her—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I'm... scared...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(The more important the match is... I'm 
sure I...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Found you... Big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You startled me, running off all of a 
sudden like that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If you're having trouble, talk to me... 
After all, I'm your Muse Maid, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, Vivlos. 
It's nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I was just, well... feeling a little 
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! ...I see~. 
Sorry, I just thought you never got 
nervous, Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because you're so strong!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Me, strong...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really true, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup! Because you never give up, Big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We watched that race video at the 
checkpoint earlier, right? 
That reminded me of how I felt back then 
at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You were so, so strong, Big sis! 
In the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba, and the 
Shuka Sho—in all of them!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you placed second in every single 
one! That's super amazing! 
And yet, you weren't satisfied at all—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You never took your eyes off 
Gentildonna-san! 
With burning eyes, you stared right at 
her, determined not to give up until you 
won!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I might've gotten scared. 
But you never ever give up, Big sis.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And because you haven't given up, 
you decided to challenge this audition, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because you want her to see you, right? 
—You want Gentildonna-san to see you 
challenging her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I really think that makes you so strong! 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A big sister who never gives up is the 
strongest Umamusume of all!
